Fixed: `d.tz` in src/plugin/timezone/index.js now returns `d(input).tz(timezone)` for non-string input (timestamp, js Date, Day.js object), so `dayjs.tz(ts, zone)` matches moment-timezone. Verified: test/plugin/timezone.test.js 14/14 pass, full suite 524/524 pass.

Fixed: `proto.tz` now rounds the minute diff (`Math.round(...)`), so the offset is an integer and `format('Z')` returns e.g. '-07:00' instead of a fractional value when the instance has milliseconds. Verified against moment-timezone; test/plugin/timezone.test.js 14/14 pass.
Fixed: src/locale/nl.js `ordinal` now returns the Dutch ordinal (`1ste`, `2de`, ... `8ste`, `20ste`), matching moment's nl locale for days 1-31 (`Do`). Full suite still passes.

Fixed: src/plugin/weekYear/index.js now also returns `year - 1` when `month === 0 && weekOfYear >= 52`, so January dates in the last week of the previous week-year match moment (e.g. 2021-01-01 -> 2020, 2023-01-01 -> 2022). Verified over 102 dates across new-year windows; weekYear/advancedFormat/weekOfYear tests pass.

Fixed: src/plugin/customParseFormat/index.js now parses locale meridiems for the `A`/`a` tokens (uses the locale's `meridiem` when present, falling back to English AM/PM). `dayjs('2018-05-02 上午 1:02:03', 'YYYY-MM-DD A h:mm:ss', 'zh-cn')` -> 01:02:03 and `下午` -> 13:02:03. customParseFormat tests 38/38 pass, full suite 524/524 pass.

Fixed: src/plugin/duration/index.js `unitToMS` was missing `milliseconds: 1`, so `dayjs.duration(1, 'ms')` (and `add(n,'ms')`) produced NaN. Now matches moment for ms inputs; duration tests 14/14 and full suite 524/524 pass.
